verdict.rationale: Letta ships an official Agent SDK for building agents into applications (TypeScript SDK per letta-gh-1, Agent SDK docs in letta-docs-1/2/11), plus an App Server exposing agents to client apps via the SDK, with runtime probes confirming the CLI and server actually run. This directly matches the story of building against official SDKs. Missing for 10: no independent third-party corroboration of SDK usage beyond docs, and no explicit multi-language SDK coverage (only TS SDK mentioned) or OpenAPI spec (probe found openapi endpoints 404).
